title: fix(app-shell): approval history rows draw the authored step label (objectui#13248)
body:
Fixes #13248

Clause-②: no

## What changed

`RecordApprovalsPanel`'s action history now names each row's step by the label the flow author wrote. A row whose request carries a `step_label` draws that label. A row whose request carries none draws the prettified `step_name`, as before. The header and the rows go through one function, `stepDisplayText`, so their rules cannot drift.

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordApprovalsPanel.tsx`: the history row and the header.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordApprovalsPanel.actionStepLabel-13248.test.tsx`: new, four cases.
- `.changeset/13248-approval-history-step-label.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

No server change, no new package export, and the inbox page is untouched. The row's step text gains `data-testid="approval-action-step"`.

## Route change: the row reads its request's label, not `a.step_label`

The card's Done-when says the row "shows `a.step_label` when one is present". I measured this before writing code. The rows the panel reads never carry that field.

- The panel reads `GET /approvals/requests/:id/actions`. That route returns `listActions`, which maps every row through `rowFromAction` in objectstack's `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts`. `rowFromAction` names `step_name` and not `step_label`. I read it at objectui's pin (`.objectstack-sha` = `f4755a68a`) and at objectstack `origin/main` `3fbef41b4`. Both are the same.
- The spec contract `ApprovalActionRow` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/approval-service.ts`) declares `step_name` and no `step_label`, at the pin and on `main`.
- This read has no `$select`. The client asks for a request's thread by id, and the server picks the columns.

So code that read `a.step_label` would draw the same prettified name on every backend that exists today, and the HotCRM reading would not change. Making the server serve the field is the server change the card rules out.

The server does give us the value another way. The stored `sys_approval_action.step_label` is a copy of the owning request's step label:

- At `f4755a68a`, every `insert('sys_approval_action', ...)` call in `approval-service.ts` builds its row through `actionRow(request, ...)` (`grep -c` gives 15 inserts and 15 `actionRow` calls). `actionRow` writes `step_label: requestDisplayLabels(request).current_step_label`.
- The request doors serve that same value as `step_label`. In `rowFromRequest`, `labels = requestDisplayLabels(row)` and `step_label: labels.current_step_label`. `ApprovalRequestRow` declares `step_label`, and `ApprovalRequestLite` already does too.
- The panel already holds those request rows (the get and the list both map through `rowFromRequest`). It reads the action threads by those requests' ids, so every timeline row's request is in hand.

The row now looks up its request's `step_label` by `request_id`. That is the value the server stored on the action row, and it comes from a field the contract declares. No key is added to `ApprovalActionLite`.

One side effect: the header and the rows now read one served value. When objectstack-ai/objectstack#24863 localizes the step label where the request is served, the rows will change along with the header.

## Tests

`RecordApprovalsPanel.actionStepLabel-13248.test.tsx` has four cases. Its stub action rows carry what the actions door sends: a `step_name` and no `step_label`. Every row is awaited before any assertion runs, which is the settle rule of `RecordApprovalsPanel.viaOverrideMarker.test.tsx`.

1. Each row draws its request's step label, not the prettified node id. In a two-level flow, the level-1 rows read "Sales Manager Review" and the level-2 row reads "Finance Director Sign-off".
2. When the requests carry no step label, the rows fall back to the prettified `step_name`: "Manager Review" and "Finance Review".
3. The decision is per row. A labelled request's row keeps its label next to an unlabelled request's fallback, in the same DOM.
4. The header and the pending request's row draw the same step text.

**Ablation.** I ran one, on the committed fix at `11ac365`, using objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. It replaced the row's lookup `stepDisplayText(stepLabelByRequest.get(a.request_id), a.step_name)` with `stepDisplayText(null, a.step_name)`, which is the old row behaviour.

- The tool's on-disk check: anchor x1 to x0, replacement x0 to x1, blob `e808998a62ba` to `5e5221616d94`.
- Predicted: cases 1, 3 and 4 red, case 2 green. Observed: `Tests 3 failed | 1 passed (4)`. Case 1 received "· Manager Review" where it expected "· Sales Manager Review", and case 4 received "· Finance Review".
- Restore: the blob is back to `e808998a62ba`, equal to HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The test imports the panel by relative path, so it resolves to source and no `dist` rebuild was involved.

## Local gates, run at head `1f5b8dc`

- `pnpm exec vitest run` over 11 files: the new one, the six other `RecordApprovalsPanel*` suites, and the four approval suites of `RecordDetailView` (`recordOpenRequests-12701`, `approvalDeclaredActions`, `approvalLock-12220`, `approvalRecallGate`). Result: `Test Files 11 passed (11)`, `Tests 68 passed (68)`, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0. `--listFilesOnly` on the test project lists the new file.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell lint`: 0 errors, exit 0. The new file has no warnings.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations, exit 0.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: exit 0.
- `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals` and `check:unreferenced-sources`: each exit 0.
- The dependency closure built first: `pnpm turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2` reported 28 of 28 tasks successful, exit 0.

Repo-wide lint and the full test farm are left to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- **The actions door does not serve the action's own display columns.** `GET /approvals/requests/:id/actions` (`rowFromAction`) leaves out `step_label`, `acted_as_label`, `object_name` and `record_id`, even though `sys_approval_action` stores all four. This is an observation and was not filed. The contract does not declare them, and after this change no objectui reader needs `step_label` from that door. Carrier: none.

## Seeing it in a browser

I did not take this reading. On the showcase backend with `--seed-admin`, the `showcase_invoice_signoff` flow runs on `showcase_invoice`. Setting an invoice's status to Sent (the form then also requires Issued On) opens a request at node `dual_signoff`, whose authored label is "Finance + Legal Sign-off". On that invoice's record page, the history rows should read "· Finance + Legal Sign-off". Before this change they read "· Dual Signoff". Row selector: `[data-testid="record-approvals-panel"] li [data-testid="approval-action-step"]`.
